summary.en: Same hits, higher ticket prices, optional new album nobody asked for.
summary.zh: 还是那些热歌，票价更高，可选附赠一张没人点名的新专。

body.en:
The honest pitch: we need the money / we miss the volume / the kids never saw us. The dishonest pitch: "we have unfinished artistic business."

Sometimes the chemistry returns. Sometimes it is a karaoke franchise with original faces. Check whether they play the deep cuts they gatekept you for—or just the singles that paid for the private jet.
body.zh:
诚实说法：要钱 / 想听响 / 下一代没见过现场。不诚实说法：「我们还有未完成的艺术使命。」

有时化学反应真回来。有时就是原班卡拉 OK 加盟店。看看他们是演当年拿来门禁你的深切——还是只演付私人飞机的那几首单曲。

note.en: Multiple "final" runs; Ozzy-era nostalgia as product.
note.zh: 多次「最后巡演」；Ozzy 期怀旧做成商品。

note.en: Long wait, big rooms, same two albums in the bloodstream.
note.zh: 等很久、场地很大，血管里还是那两张专。
